server.name: io.github.Lykhoyda/ask-ollama
server.description: Bridge Claude with local Ollama LLMs for private AI-to-AI collaboration — no API keys, fully local

environmentVariables.description: Ollama server address (default: http://localhost:11434)
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for Ollama execution in milliseconds (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)
environmentVariables.name: GMCPT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error (default: warn)
environmentVariables.name: GMCPT_LOG_LEVEL
